svg.title: Lantern Vale — village building upgrade prototypes
svg.desc: Visual structural upgrade paths for woodcutter, workshop and farm, and five existing town hall visual stages. Current footprints and gameplay rules are preserved. Capacity and equipment upgrades remain separate.

g.text: LANTERN VALE / VILLAGE BUILDINGS / UPGRADE PROTOTYPES
More established, still the same village.
Structural upgrades: recognisable roofs, stronger timber and stone foundations. Worker capacity stays independent.
1×1 tile · SAME FOOTPRINT AT EVERY LEVEL
Simple shelter and a clear splitting block.
Braced posts and a stronger front beam.
Stone footings and iron post collars.
2×2 tiles · SAME FOOTPRINT AT EVERY LEVEL
Open bench, hand tools and timber stock.
Masonry footings beneath the open work shed.
1×1 tile · SAME FOOTPRINT AT EVERY LEVEL
Timber farmstead with a produce hatch.
Framed walls and stronger roof trim.
Stone base, reinforced posts and a gable vent.
Hall levels 5–10 share the current final visual stage. No extra gameplay tiers are proposed.
DESIGN REVIEW ONLY · structural artwork · capacity and equipment upgrades remain separate
